failed_witnesses.description: A broad worktree-list probe returned no usable output inside its bounded display window.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Replace it with literal branch, path, ref, and Git-metadata probes; do not enumerate sibling lanes.

failed_witnesses.description: The first scalar source wrapper omitted git -C and overescaped its word-count expression.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Rerun only exact repository-qualified scalar probes and use the committed packet hash as the integrity gate.

failed_witnesses.description: The first 260-line packet display truncated before EOF.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Measure the packet and reread numbered 100-line UTF-8 windows through the exact final line.

failed_witnesses.description: A generic keyword projection over-rendered repeated schema prose and truncated.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Use exact headings and bounded line windows only after the complete packet read is established.

failed_witnesses.description: Historical skill names and one guessed authorization skill name were absent.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Resolve observed family-current skill names and treat absent historical names as unavailable rather than inventing replacements.

failed_witnesses.description: The first authorization current-state JSON display truncated mid-file.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Reread the UTF-8 file in four numbered bounded chunks through line 1556 and EOF.

failed_witnesses.description: A Git common-directory projection incorrectly joined an already absolute path.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Test whether the returned path is rooted before resolving it.

failed_witnesses.description: The first exact worktree-metadata wrapper stopped before its final match-count scalar.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Use exact path, local-ref, remote-ref, and Git worktree-add collision guards; award no metadata-wrapper credit.

failed_witnesses.description: Sparse patterns were configured after --no-checkout while the new index remained empty, exposing 8282 apparent staged deletions.
failed_witnesses.recovery: In the empty owner-only lane, run git read-tree -mu HEAD once, then require a clean index, all inherited paths skip-worktree, and zero materialized tracked files.

failed_witnesses.description: A verified recursive cleanup request for two owner-lane bytecode cache directories was rejected by the command policy before execution.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Retain the ignored cache files locally, perform no recursive deletion, and exclude ignored bytecode from every Git manifest and staged surface.

failed_witnesses.description: A second explicit-file and non-recursive empty-directory cleanup request was also rejected by the command policy before execution.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Stop cleanup retries, retain the ignored local cache files, and disable future bytecode writes while keeping the tracked lane clean.

failed_witnesses.description: The first exact-file x1 Ruff gate found three import-block ordering findings.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Apply Ruff's safe import-only rewrites to the three Auren x1 Python files, rebuild deterministic receipts, and rerun only the scoped gate.

recovery_rule: A recovery is a distinct bounded method and never erases or relabels the failed witness.
